name: Martyr / Role Model
life_theme: Three-phase life: trial (0-30), roof (30-50), role model (50+). Embody wisdom accumulated across all phases.
work_pattern: First half of career marked by experimentation and discovery of what works. From mid-career, become a trusted observer and synthesiser. Later, become the role model whose lived wisdom inspires others.
career_approach: Accept that your early career is meant to be exploratory. Don't rush to 'find your thing' — you're building material for later wisdom. After 30-35, start transitioning from experimenter to synthesiser.
growth_edge: Trusting the process during the 'roof' phase — observation feels passive but is essential.
